gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).

gaps.explanation: 'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.
